gcp.functions.v1.max_instances.note: Maximum instances of a 1st gen function when max_instances is 0 ("If you don't specify a limit, Cloud Run functions sets a default of 3000"). The quotas page says 1st gen HTTP functions have no default limit and recommends setting one such as 3,000 (https://docs.cloud.google.com/functions/quotas), so for HTTP functions this is the recommended cap rather than an enforced one
